claim_tiers.T1: Scoped causal active-plan signal only; no deployable memory/checkpoint/persistence/utility claim.
claim_tiers.T2: Untouched within-model replication with site/statistics frozen.
claim_tiers.T3: Single-source checkpoint: counterfactual B unavailable to extractor at test time.
claim_tiers.T4: Plan-not-action-feature: one-time restore survives first-action clamp and affects later branch.
claim_tiers.T5: Compact persistent agent state: honest bytes/bits including global basis plus matched text/KV/generic-memory baselines and end-task utility.
claim_tiers.T6: High-tier generalization: second model family + second interactive environment + end-task utility, no benchmark-switch rescue.

current_scientific_stage: T1 candidate only; Experiment 9701014b-3418-46a2-acb4-d59f235388dc remains NOT_ASSESSED.

high_tier_positioning.conditional_mechanism_headline_after_T1_: Active plan identity has a prospectively replicated causal internal component under matched observable state.
high_tier_positioning.conditional_method_headline_after_T3_T5: A causally identified single-source plan checkpoint can be restored after interruption, persists beyond immediate steering, and is compact under honest storage accounting.
high_tier_positioning.forbidden_headline: A new latent memory method for ALFWorld agents.
high_tier_positioning.target_main_track_headline_after_T6: Causal plan-state checkpointing is a reproducible interruption mechanism across model/environment families with demonstrated long-horizon utility.

T1: Function-vector/generic perturbation controls represented by archived/random/unrelated controls
T2: Independent untouched confirmation; no new system baselines needed if claim remains causal-localization only.
T4: Where's the Plan? distinction via first-action clamp/later branch
T5: full KV/full residual/full plan text/matched-token summary
T6: architecture-dependent activation-transfer literature interpreted as conditional, not universal

paper_structure_if_T1_negative: Report valid causal kill test as scoped negative mechanism evidence if scientifically informative.
Do not build/benchmark a memory module to rescue the null.
Next mechanism question: distributed multi-token/multi-layer state versus reconstructive/no-persistent-state explanation.
paper_structure_if_T1_positive: Persistence mediation: first-action clamp + later branch
principle: Do not burden T1 with system-performance comparisons that only become meaningful after a deployable single-source checkpoint exists. Conversely, do not promote a T1 causal-localization result into a memory/persistence/utility paper without T3-T6 gates.

must_not_claim: first demonstration that plans decay from hidden state
first evidence that plan text/context is load-bearing
prior_work_matrix.prior: Plans Don't Persist: Why Context Management Is Load Bearing for LLM Agents
prior_work_matrix.prior_scope: Diagnoses rapid plan-signal decay/context dependence with replay pairing, probes, stripping controls and ALFWorld compression stress; naive eviction harms success and probe-gated resurfacing does not recover it.
required_gate: T1 matched A<->B active-plan intervention beating lexical/random/unrelated controls
T3 single-source checkpoint from actually active plan only
T4 multi-step/first-action-clamp evidence before persistence claim
prior_work_matrix.surviving_differential: Causal identification of plan identity under matched observable state and later checkpoint/restore of that causal carrier.

must_not_claim: first causal localization of planning representations
activation patching of a plan representation is itself novel
prior_work_matrix.prior: Where's the Plan? Locating Latent Planning in Language Models with Lightweight Mechanistic Interventions
prior_work_matrix.prior_scope: Uses probes and activation patching to locate forward-looking planning information and causally influence generation across model families.
required_gate: T1 reciprocal matched-state plan-order intervention
T4 later divergence after common/forced first action
T6 second-model replication
prior_work_matrix.surviving_differential: Interruption-specific active-plan identity causally transported into a fresh-context continuation under identical external state/prompt.

must_not_claim: hidden states as memory are novel
latent memory is novel
prior_work_matrix.prior: TransMem: Transforming Hidden States into Memory for Large Language Models
prior_work_matrix.prior_scope: Uses transformed sparse historical hidden states as reusable latent memory via a learned memory/gating module.
required_gate: T1 plan-specific causal identification
T3 compare single-source PlanCarry checkpoint against generic historical hidden-state memory
T5 matched storage/utility accounting
prior_work_matrix.surviving_differential: Episode-specific plan-control state identified causally, then checkpointed/restored rather than generic historical-state memory.

must_not_claim: hidden-state transport itself is novel
training-free latent transfer itself is novel
prior_work_matrix.prior: StateBridge: Training-free Hidden-state Alignment for Latent Communication in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
prior_work_matrix.prior_scope: Training-free alignment and transport of hidden states between inference agents/contexts using continuous prefix states.
required_gate: T3 direct latent-transport baseline if implementation permits
T4 prove transported state controls later plan branch rather than only first output
T6 cross-model transfer only after within-model checkpoint support
prior_work_matrix.surviving_differential: Plan-specific causal checkpoint/restore across interruption, with donor identity tied to active plan rather than generic sender state.

must_not_claim: causal activation transfer itself is novel
cross-model activation transfer is uniformly reliable
prior_work_matrix.prior: Architecture-Dependent Causal Transfer of Activation States Across Large Language Models
prior_work_matrix.prior_scope: Demonstrates end-to-end causal activation-state transfer can work for some cross-model pairs and fail for others.
required_gate: T1 content-specific plan contrast
T3 single-source checkpoint
T6 treat cross-model replication as a separate architecture-dependent test with failures reported
prior_work_matrix.surviving_differential: Active-plan-specific source state, matched counterfactual identification, interruption checkpoint/restore, and plan-branch outcome.

must_not_claim: state-conditioned memory for embodied agents is novel
latent/soft memory channel is novel
ALFWorld or ScienceWorld memory gains are novel
prior_work_matrix.prior: MemCompiler: Compile, Don't Inject -- State-Conditioned Memory for Embodied Agents
prior_work_matrix.prior_scope: State-conditioned memory compilation for embodied agents with text + latent Soft-Mem channels; evaluated on ALFWorld/ScienceWorld/EmbodiedBench with reported performance/latency benefits.
required_gate: Do NOT add as a T1 performance baseline
At T5 compare end-task utility and cost against state-conditioned memory when a deployable checkpoint exists
At T6 include second-environment comparison if semantics align
prior_work_matrix.surviving_differential: Causal identification and restoration of the model's own episode-specific active plan state, rather than learned compilation from an external memory store.

must_not_claim: adaptive latent-memory allocation is novel
learned latent memory for agents is novel
ALFWorld latent-memory gains establish novelty
prior_work_matrix.prior: ElasticMem: Latent Memory as a Learnable Resource for LLM Agents
prior_work_matrix.prior_scope: Learned latent-memory bank, hidden-state-conditioned retrieval and adaptive latent budget; includes ALFWorld gains and reusable evidence/plan memory.
required_gate: No T1 performance comparison required
T5 storage-normalized comparison: per-episode payload + global basis/projection overhead vs ElasticMem memory bank/budget
T5/T6 TaskSuccess and latency/token/byte accounting
prior_work_matrix.surviving_differential: Causally identified active-plan checkpoint with no memory-bank learning required for T1-T4; later compare true checkpoint payload/utility against learned latent memory.

must_not_claim: KV-cache latent steering is novel
persistent latent guidance without text replay is novel
prior_work_matrix.prior: Memory Inception: Latent-Space KV Cache Manipulation for Steering LLMs
prior_work_matrix.prior_scope: Training-free text-derived KV-bank insertion at selected layers for persistent/updateable latent steering.
required_gate: T3 compare against text-derived KV/latent steering if architecture permits
T4 one-time restore + later-branch persistence
T5 full-KV versus compact checkpoint storage accounting
prior_work_matrix.surviving_differential: Checkpoint extracted from the agent's own active pre-interruption plan and causally validated by A<->B matched plan identity.

must_not_claim: compact causal internal vectors are novel
activation vectors controlling behavior are novel
prior_work_matrix.prior: Function Vectors in Large Language Models
prior_work_matrix.prior_scope: Identifies compact causal internal vectors for abstract input-output functions and uses interventions to trigger task behavior.
required_gate: T1 archived/unrelated/random specificity controls
T4 first-action clamp/mediation and later divergence
T5 necessity/sufficiency and dimension/storage ablations
prior_work_matrix.surviving_differential: Episode-specific active-plan carrier, not a generic task/function vector; later persistence must survive controls for immediate action features.
